families.serialization: Host save carries `SerializableRun.SchemaVersion/GameMode/Ascension/Modifiers/PlatformType`; build identity comes from `ReleaseInfo`, adapter revision from the mod package (not a host member).
families.ordering: Scalar values; `Modifiers` and `BadgeModels` are `IReadOnlyList` and keep host order.
families.restore: Compatibility is checked, never restored: a differing build, adapter, mode, character, ascension, modifier, or profile tuple rejects the checkpoint (ADR 0042 stays `no_restore_adapter`).
families.unknown_policy: Any missing tuple element rejects capture with `unsupported_coverage`; no default build, mode, or profile is assumed.

families.serialization: Host saves the string seed plus one counter per stream (`SerializableRunRngSet.Counters`, `SerializablePlayerRngSet.Counters`), not the four `UInt64` state words; a checkpoint carries stream seed and counter per `RunRngType`/`PlayerRngType` and pins the derivation constructor version.
families.ordering: Streams are keyed by enum in `Dictionary<RunRngType,Rng>`; canonical order is the enum ordinal, never dictionary iteration order.
families.restore: Host-owned via `RunRngSet.LoadFromSerializable` and `Rng.FastForwardCounter`; the mod never writes a cursor (ADR 0040).
families.unknown_policy: A stream whose `Seed` or `Counter` cannot be observed rejects capture; `Chaotic` streams are recorded as present but never certified deterministic.

families.ordering: `Acts`, `VisitedMapCoords`, `MapPointHistory`, and `_currentRooms` are lists and keep host order; `ActMap.startMapPoints`, `MapPoint.parents/Children`, and `_visitedEventIds` are hash sets and are sorted canonically by `MapCoord(col,row)` or `ModelId` before encoding.
families.restore: Host-owned through the save loader; the mod records `RunLocation`/`MapLocation` and room `Id` for identity only.
families.unknown_policy: A null `CurrentMapCoord`, a missing `CurrentRoom`, or a room without a resolvable encounter or event identity rejects capture; no earlier floor is substituted.

families.serialization: `SerializablePlayer` carries character, hp, gold, energy, potion-slot count, `Deck` as `List<SerializableCard>` (`Id/CurrentUpgradeLevel/Enchantment/Props/FloorAddedToDeck`), `Relics`, `Potions`, and `RelicGrabBag`; combat piles are not part of the host run save.
families.ordering: `CardPile._cards`, `_relics`, `_potionSlots`, `_runPiles`, and the `RelicGrabBag._deques` values are lists whose order is gameplay-affecting and is retained; `CardModel._keywords/_tags` are hash sets and are sorted canonically.
families.restore: Host-owned; the mod never constructs a card, relic, or potion (ADR 0042).
families.unknown_policy: A card without a resolvable `Pile`, `Owner`, or upgrade level, or a relic without `Status`, rejects capture; unreadable temporary card values are never encoded as defaults. No key-style resource member exists on this build (`metadata-absent`), so the ADR 0037 `keys` item has no host closure.

families.serialization: Combat state is not part of the single-player host run save (`SerializableRoom.EncounterState` is a string map and `NetFullCombatState` is a multiplayer carrier); a combat checkpoint must serialize the owned values listed here itself.
families.ordering: `Allies/Enemies/Creatures`, the combat piles, `_powers`, `_orbs`, `_pets`, and `StateLog` are lists and keep host order; `_playersReadyToEndTurn` is a hash set.
families.restore: No host-owned combat restore path is observed; ADR 0042 stays `no_restore_adapter`.
families.unknown_policy: Capture is refused unless `CombatManager.IsInProgress` holds with `PlayerTurnPhase.Play`, an empty `ActionQueueSet`, `ActionExecutor.IsRunning` false, and no action in `GatheringPlayerChoice`; a `PowerModel._internalData` (`Object`) that cannot be typed rejects capture.

families.serialization: Offers and pending choices are not fully serialized by the host run save (`SerializableRoom.ExtraRewards/EventId` and `SerializableRun.EventsSeen` only); a checkpoint must copy the offer values listed here.
families.ordering: `RewardsSet.Rewards`, `CardReward.Cards`, `EventModel.CurrentOptions`, the merchant entry lists, and `RestSiteRoom.Options` are lists and keep host order.
families.restore: No host-owned restore path for a pending offer is observed; these rows stay `unsupported pending inventory` in the boundary matrix.
families.unknown_policy: An offer with `_isGenerated`/`IsPopulated` false, an unresolved `_rngOverride`, a merchant entry without `Cost`, or a pending `PlayerChoiceContext` rejects capture.

families.serialization: `SerializableRun` through `SaveManager.SaveRun/LoadRunSave` (System.Text.Json via `MegaCritSerializerContext`); canonical checkpoint bytes are mod-owned `asc-jcs-state-v1` (ADR 0054), not a host format.
families.ordering: The identity tuple is fixed by the mod (ADR 0055); host lists keep order and host hash sets are sorted canonically before encoding.
families.restore: Restore stays unsupported (ADR 0042); duplicate admission and the durable-versus-in-memory distinction are mod-owned (ADR 0055).
families.unknown_policy: A missing `RunManager.State`, an uninitialized profile, `IsAbandoned` or `IsGameOver` true, or a pending `CurrentRunSaveTask` rejects capture.

families.serialization: Wall-clock values are saved as `Int64` (`SaveTime/StartTime/RunTime/WinTime`, `DailyTime`); object IDs are `UInt32`/`Int32` counters; hash-set contents are saved as lists.
families.ordering: Every hash set listed here has no host-defined order and must be sorted canonically before encoding; task and cancellation members are timing inputs, not state.
families.restore: Not restorable and not part of identity except the daily seed date; the mod records them as declared external inputs.
families.unknown_policy: A checkpoint taken while `_actionCancelToken`, `_executionTask`, or `_deferredEndTurnTransition` is live is refused as `busy`; an unknown ordering source fails closed.

families.ordering: Not ordered; excluded from identity only after a live run proves it cannot affect gameplay state.
families.unknown_policy: Metadata shows these members exist; it cannot show they are gameplay-neutral, so this row stays `unverified` for the ADR 0040 required finding.

enumeration_rule: Every row names one exact host type and member; the full type name, member name, and member kind match ordinally. A row that does not resolve is reported unresolved and is never substituted, relaxed, or omitted, and a family with any unresolved row or no rows fails closed.
limitation: Metadata proves that a member exists with a declared type on the hashed assembly. It cannot prove serialization, restore responsibility, ordering, unknown-value handling, RNG consumption, thread affinity, or that a capture is coherent; those stay runtime-unverified until an authorized exact-host run records them. No row is native-verified.
